messages.content: Determine the winner in a Poker game with John having a Hand of 8♥, 10♥, J♥, Q♥, K♥ and Mike having 9♠, J♠, 10♠, Q♠, K♠.

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content: Mike wins. Both players have flushes with the same top card (King), but Mike’s remaining cards are higher (9 ♠ vs. 8 ♥). Therefore Mike takes the hand.
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush from 8 to K? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K is a straight flush (8-9-10-J-Q-K? Wait missing 9). Straight flush requires consecutive ranks. John's cards: 8,10,J,Q,K. Missing 9. So not a straight flush. It's a flush (all hearts). Highest card K. Mike has 9♠, J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠. That's also a flush (all spades). Highest card K. Both have same high card K. Next compare next highest: J vs J equal. Next: Q vs Q equal. Next: 10 vs 10 equal. Next: 8 vs 9? John's 8, Mike's 9. So Mike has higher kicker. So Mike wins. So answer: Mike wins.
